package lint

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestNoEmptyFunctionSelected(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	directory, err := filepath.Abs(".")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var rows []string
	for _, row := range upstream(t) {
		if strings.Split(row, "\t")[1] == "no-empty-function" {
			rows = append(rows, row)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("no-empty-function upstream cases: %d", len(rows))
	if len(rows) < 2313 {
		t.Fatalf("incomplete upstream corpus: %d", len(rows))
	}
	for _, descriptor := range prepareRegistry(t, ".") {
		if descriptor.Name == "no-empty-function" {
			rows = append(rows, ownedWitnessRows(t, directory, descriptor)...)
			break
		}
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, row := range generated(t) {
		source := strings.SplitN(row, "\t", 2)[0]
		if !seen[source] {
			rows = append(rows, source+"\tno-empty-function")
			seen[source] = true
		}
	}
	oracle := goOracle(t)
	compare(t, oracle, buildPort(t, directory, true), directory, manifest(t, recoveryRows(t, oracle, rows)))
	var change struct{ Name, From, To string }
	data, err := os.ReadFile("rules/no-empty-function/mutant.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &change); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	changed := mutant(t, change.From, change.To, "rules/no-empty-function/rule.a")
	witnesses := ownedWitnesses(t, directory, "no-empty-function")
	var mutantRows []string
	for _, source := range witnesses {
		mutantRows = append(mutantRows, source+"\tno-empty-function")
	}
	path := manifest(t, recoveryRows(t, oracle, mutantRows))
	want := execute(t, "", oracle, "--manifest", path).output
	baseline := compare(t, oracle, buildPort(t, directory, true), directory, path)
	if !bytes.Equal(baseline, want) {
		t.Fatal("mutant baseline differs")
	}
	for _, side := range []struct {
		name string
		run  execution
	}{
		{"Node", node(t, changed, path, false)},
		{"emitted JavaScript", emittedNode(t, changed, path, false)},
		{"sanitized native", execute(t, "", buildMutantPort(t, changed), "--manifest", path)},
	} {
		if bytes.Equal(side.run.output, want) {
			t.Fatalf("mutant survived on %s", side.name)
		}
		t.Logf("%s caught on %s: %s", change.Name, side.name, difference(side.run.output, want))
	}
}
